title: Unlocking Memories
content: Okay so until 2 nights ago I thought that I only had one Mallworld dream - the weird toilet place - and only once. Then I had a dream about a water park with really weird slides that transitioned to a mall. I’ve been trying to write down my dreams because since I became a fan of The Backrooms I haven’t been able to remember my dreams for the most part (it took me 3 months to remember one and since then it’s usually just snippets or a feeling). It’s just black and nothing when I wake up. I don’t know if that’s connected but anyways I’m going off track. The dream I recalled from 2 nights ago is only the 2nd full dream I remember in 6 months (the first one I’m not sure if it was Mallworld as it seemed to be starting at a mall, then I was chased by security and following someone (managed to shake the security) through black/blue stone hallways so I thought it was more Backrooms related (I never found out who the person was). So all of yesterday I had this nagging feeling about the previous nights dream. I felt like the memory of it was just out of reach. And eventually it all came back to me as realistic as the previous Mallworld dream. But the weird thing was that as I was writing my dream journal all of these other dreams came flashing back to me. The more I wrote the more became unlocked. Some of these dreams were from years ago I think but had been lost in my subconscious. But all of them seemed like realistic memories. - At least a couple of water park dreams, the slides are usually repeating and after each slide the area looks different. - A mall with many escalators including some that lead to nowhere, the same mall also had a lot of corridors and many closed stores. - A cave like system which was entered via a hidden passageway or sewer entrance. - A really tall modern glass building that seemed to go on forever but had an old fashioned lobby that had seen better days. The elevators didn’t stop on every floor so you had to swap elevators sometimes. - A multi-story carpark that didn’t have many car parking spaces but instead many circular roads. It was concrete and there were connecting stairs and tunnels. - A road that had circular sections that seemed to lead to nowhere or ended in u-turns. There was also a multi-laned bridge. - A grocery store that was missing all of the items I wanted to buy but when I went back everything was there. - An old abandoned house/mansion which was at the bottom of a valley and hard to find. Outside there were overgrown gardens and it looked old. But inside there were many hallways and rooms and everything was in pristine condition. I remember two versions of this place - the other wasn’t in a valley but was an old house that transitioned to a modern house with a huge glass covered staircase and atrium. I feel there are more but these are the ones I have currently remembered. Some of them seem like locations I have seen on here but others don’t. But I know I definitely dreamt these in the past. Has anyone else had a case of a possible Mallworld dream unlocking other dreams or memories of such?
